title: Find the Second Largest Element
description: Given an array of integers `nums`, find the second largest distinct element. If no second largest distinct element exists, return -1.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
output_format: The second largest distinct element or -1.

sample_tests.explanation: Largest is 35, second largest distinct is 34.

hints: Track largest and second largest in a single linear scan.
Ensure the second largest is strictly less than the largest.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    u = sorted(list(set(nums)), reverse=True)
    print(u[1] if len(u) > 1 else -1)
